scope: One setup-only diagnostic on the selected disposable Intel macOS host; no application acceptance.

verification.countRule: Independent rerun of the same two formal cases; nested checks and independent reruns are not additional application cases.

resolvedReviewFindings: Creation, boot and boot-readiness timeouts now trigger the same one-shot diagnostic as metadata timeouts. The earlier114-second creation observation is close enough to its120-second cap that omitting this path could have lost the next useful failure.
Both support-helper digests are checked before any helper import executes.
Runner provenance is restricted to ImageOS, ImageVersion and RUNNER_ARCH; command arguments and environment contents are not retained.
Snapshot and sampling overhead is explicit, and successful setup in this probe cannot by itself establish a cure or native application acceptance.

reviewedBehavior.sampleTargets: Exact still-live owned command and at most one same-UID, exact-identifier, Apple-signature-verified CoreSimulatorService
